steps.step: registry lists seeded agreements with status, version and review queue
maker creates a package (API) and sees it in the registry
dual-role user extracts; cannot approve own extraction (UI disabled + API 403 SELF_APPROVAL) - C-A07/G15
maker role (not checker) has Approve disabled; viewer is read-only
independent checker approves every proposed field with a reason (UI)
maker proposes freeze; a DIFFERENT checker session finds the pending approval and freezes the exact hash -> v1
frozen terms are read-only (UI message; API 409 FIELD_FROZEN)
amendment filed in the UI (10m -> 8m effective 2026-09-01), extracted, approved, frozen -> v2 (G08)
compare v1 vs v2 and resolve before/after 2026-09-01: threshold 10,000,000 -> 8,000,000; history unchanged
G14: unresolved rating trigger BLOCKS; a sourced fact resolves the conditional term
G09: cross-master trade registered in the UI is REJECTED and listed in quarantine
tenant B cannot read tenant A's package (404, no leakage)
no unexpected console errors or 5xx during the flows
